adaptations: Files navigation uses the existing island drop folder export; Files has no separate frame and follows the settings layout. Preset limits use two columns at desktop widths so all integration controls remain visible.
Help uses the secondary text token where tertiary contrast is insufficient. Activity priority has accessible Up/Down controls and Alt+Arrow keys on the original drag grip.

Version is read from package metadata. v0.1 custom/empty shortcuts and preferences are preserved. Shortcut editing remains functional through existing fields; V6.4 owns the recorder/conflict interaction and final shortcut-row treatment.
The native window uses OS decorations and taskbar presence. Close is also available in the content header for preview and keyboard access.

rendering.scope: Owned headless browsers and acceptance WebViews only; no user/browser/OS setting is changed.
rendering.method: Raw CDP captures at requested device scale with reduced motion, all images/fonts loaded and exact repeated PNG hashes.
rendering.diagnostic: v61-raster-c.json records six consecutive identical readbacks for both affected pages after compositor scheduling was made deterministic. Previous failed runs and originals are retained.
rendering.native: Native PNGs contain owned WebView pixels, including transparency. DWM Mica is independently read on the owned HWND; no wallpaper/desktop screenshot is taken.
